visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Footer of the story body: small blue bold text links 'Disclaimers' and 'View more', each hiding small-print text (numbered footnotes; 'About AT&T' boilerplate). No rows, borders or chevrons.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Small-print text collapsed behind a plain text-link toggle
visualCharacteristics.description: Text-link toggles ('Disclaimers', 'View more') revealing small-print content

contentPattern.summary: Interactive collapsible text: content hidden behind a text toggle link. Two items: 'Disclaimers' (footnotes) and 'View more' (About AT&T). Different look from the FAQ (small text, plain text-link toggle, no chevron rows).
contentPattern.structure: one row per collapsible section with two cells: cell 1 the toggle label as plain text (e.g. 'Disclaimers', 'View more'), cell 2 the hidden content (paragraphs, footnotes with superscript numbers, links)

usage.description: Disclaimers (footnotes) and About AT&T boilerplate at the end of newsroom story pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for footnotes, disclaimers and boilerplate behind a text toggle. For Q&A lists use accordion-faq.
